rule: zig-zag radial rule (lab/zz_core.py RadialWalk, frozen) with V(r) as a phase per tick; lab/supercrit_core.py SWalk only replaces V(r); kappa = -1 (s1/2)
inputs: m_e (theta = m a), alpha, Z. DEBTS: nuclear radius R (shell R = 0.031 lambda_C for the literature comparison; uniform sphere R = 1.2 (2.5 Z)^(1/3) fm, A = 2.5 Z because no nucleus with Z > 118 exists)

error_models.point: E(a) = E0 + K a^(2 gamma) + B a^2, gamma = sqrt(1 - (Z alpha)^2), fitted on the 3 finest a
error_models.extended: X(a) = X0 + c1 a + c2 a^2 on the finest 3 or 4 a (the kink of V at R gives order a)

C1.method: secant on omega_1s(Z) + 1 = 0 (shift-invert eigenvector of W, localisation checked)

G1.method: outward recursion of W chi = lambda chi, Bloch decomposition at r_m, Breit-Wigner fit with quadratic background

G2.method: initial state = eigenstate of the walk in a box closed at the middle of the Coulomb barrier r_w = sqrt(r_in r_out) with r_in = zeta/(|E|+1), r_out = zeta/(|E|-1); evolve in a large box with sponge; Gamma from the slope of ln P(r < r_w) between P = 0.7 and 0.05

G3.a: a -> 0 extrapolated values of G1 (extra Z 181..187 added at the finest two a only, with the same method)

V1a.what: point nucleus, Z <= 110: extrapolated 1s vs Dirac formula, relative binding error

V1c.what: Z = 130, 137: prediction = LIMIT (error at the finest a > 1e-2 for Z = 137; the extrapolation is reported, threshold <= 1e-2 for Z = 130 and 137)

C1a.what: point nucleus beyond Z alpha = 1: the 1s reaches -mc^2 at a finite Z_cr(a) for every a (the lattice is a cut-off); Z_cr(a) decreases monotonically as a decreases and stays > 1/alpha

C1b.what: effective nucleus: R_eff(a) such that the continuum shell model has Z_cr(R_eff) = Z_cr(a); R_eff/a constant
C1b.threshold: max/min - 1 <= 0.10 over the 4 finest a; prediction R_eff/a in [0.2, 2]

C2a.what: shell R = 0.031: Z_cr walk (a -> 0) vs literature 177.46 (Godunov table, interpolated between Z = 177 and 178; our continuum ODE 177.463)

C3.what: uniform sphere R = 1.2 (2.5 Z)^(1/3) fm: Z_cr (a -> 0)

G1c.what: resonance energy (a -> 0) vs Godunov exact, all Z

G2.what: Gamma from the time decay vs Gamma from the phase scan, same a

G3.what: near-threshold Gamow law: ln Gamma = c0 - s 2 pi eta, eta = zeta |E_r| / sqrt(E_r^2 - 1); fit over Z = 180..188

D1.what: Z = 200: spectrum of the outgoing wave at r = 30 (positron energy): peak vs |E_r| of the phase scan, FWHM vs Gamma

literature.Godunov_2017: S.I. Godunov, B. Machet, M.I. Vysotsky, Eur. Phys. J. C 77, 782 (2017), arXiv:1707.07497
literature.Zcr_sphere: ~170 (Popov R_min = 1.2 (2.5Z)^(1/3) fm, e.g. arXiv:2209.00125), ~173 (Maltsev et al. PRL 123, 113401 (2019), Popov et al.)
literature.point_cutoff_law: zeta_cr - 1 -> pi^2 / (2 ln^2 R) for R -> 0 (Zeldovich & Popov, Sov. Phys. Usp. 14, 673 (1972)); checked here with our own continuum ODE (dev, declared)
